name: Coimbra (Portugal)
description: A gyronny flag of purple and yellow charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Coimbra above a white scroll.
history: Portuguese municipal flags follow a standard pattern of gyronny or quartered fields bearing the full civic arms; Coimbra flies purple and gold.

features.role: gyronny of eight, purple and yellow
arms of Coimbra — chalice and lion within a crowned shield
